name: hero-portfolio-dark
title: Dark Editorial Hero (Media + Text)

media: portrait/landscape image URL on the media side

locked: block nesting: group(constrained, dark surface) > media-text > content[eyebrow, h1, intro, buttons]
exactly one h1 (level 1) — this is the page's primary heading, inside the media-text content column
the media-text media slot is an image (mediaType:image); video/embed is not admitted here
parameterizationRules: mediaWidth is bounded 30-66%: below 30 the portrait collapses to a sliver on desktop, above 66 the statement copy loses the editorial column. The split is the point — keep both sides legible. Confirmed visually against the WordPress Playground render (WP 6.6, 2026-05-29).

This pattern is dark-mode by construction: the outer group carries the dark surface color and the heading/intro use a light-on-dark token pair (base/secondary). Re-skinning to light mode means swapping the surface↔text token pair together, never one alone, or contrast collapses.
notes: An asymmetric editorial alternative to the centered hero-cover: a dark full-bleed surface with a large statement h1 beside a portrait image (core/media-text). Distinctiveness comes from the token pair (dark surface + light type), the media slot, and the mediaWidth/mediaPosition split — NOT from restructuring. The h1 here is the document's single h1; downstream patterns must use h2+. The outline button uses the is-style-outline block-style variation that core provides. core/media-text is admitted to the allowlist for this pattern (image media only).
